senses.gloss: f. (= גלגליתא, v. גַּלְגְּלָא, cmp. גַּרְגַּר) wheel-work, well for irrigating fields.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 58a:16">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 91b:2">B. Bath. 91ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>אפי׳ ריש ג׳ וכ׳</he> (Ber. ed. <he>גרגי׳</he>, Ms. M. <he>גדגיד׳</he>, corr. acc., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) even a superintendent of the well (cmp. <cite ref="B00600"><he>בַּיָּיר</he></cite>) is appointed in heaven.
B. Mets. 103ᵃ if one says, ‘Lend me ההיא ג׳ the use of this well’, he may restore &c.; בי ג׳ ‘a place (in the field) for a well’,—he may go on digging wells until he strikes one that suits him.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 56a:4">B. Bath. 56ᵃ</cite>.—Pl. <he>גַּרְגּוּתֵי</he>. B. Mets. l. c.
